items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He made that with Mamie Smith... [INTERVIEWEE] I heard that record once.

ctx.x: Lady Luck blues. He made that with Mamie Smith, who was a second-rate singer for my money, but still, I guess, might have been pretty good if you'd hear it in person.
I heard that record once. Oh, this was around 1940. I've never heard it since.
